what.fr: CLR-Bench (Curriculum of Latent Rules) est un benchmark où chaque chaîne ajoute une règle cachée par niveau au-dessus des précédentes ; 20 chaînes couvrant 10 domaines sont publiées.
what.en: CLR-Bench (Curriculum of Latent Rules) is a benchmark where each chain adds one hidden rule per level on top of the earlier ones; 20 chains over 10 domains are released.

rejected.detail: The quote only supports that each chain adds one hidden rule per level; the benchmark name expansion and the release of 20 chains over 10 domains are not in the quote.

what.fr: Avec le modèle certifié, les six méthodes d'auto-évolution évaluées apprennent à peine : au mieux +5 points par rapport à un agent figé.
what.en: With the certifying model, the six self-evolution methods evaluated barely learn: the best gain at most 5 points over a frozen agent.

rejected.detail: The quote does not mention six methods or that the methods were evaluated, so the count 'six' is not established, and the quote is also truncated.

what.fr: Quand la pratique expose un membre absent de la liste, les états des agents ajoutent ce membre à la liste.
what.en: When practice exposes a member the list misses, the agents' states add that member to the list.

rejected.detail: The quote says 'they add that member to the list' with an unclear referent, and 'the agents' states' is not established by the quote alone.

what.fr: PlanAssist entre dans une phase bêta de 12 mois sur des demandes réelles, avec douze conseils supplémentaires intégrés en trois cohortes, pour un total de 15.
what.en: PlanAssist is moving into a 12-month Beta phase using live applications, with twelve more councils onboarded in three cohorts, bringing the total to 15.

rejected.detail: The quote only supports twelve more councils in three cohorts totaling 15; the 12-month Beta phase on live applications is not in the quote.

what.fr: CoFiBreak : une récompense de diversité pour les jailbreaks multi-tours
what.en: CoFiBreak: a diversity reward for multi-turn jailbreaks

rejected.detail: The statement says attacks were trained with Llama3.1-8B-Instruct as the victim and mentions HarmBench, neither of which is in the cited claims.

what.fr: Kyle Kingsbury sur la confiance à l'ère des LLM
what.en: Kyle Kingsbury on trust in the age of LLMs

rejected.detail: The statement relies on claim 835fd1406315-0, which was not established as supported, and the Jepsen/ParticleDB context is not covered by its quote.

what.fr: CoFiBreak, une récompense de diversité pour GRPO appliquée aux seules attaques dépassant un seuil d'efficacité, a atteint 98,8 % d'ASR@10 sur AdvBench. Entraînée avec Llama3.1-8B-Instruct comme victim
what.en: CoFiBreak, a diversity reward for GRPO applied only to attacks exceeding an effectiveness threshold, reached 98.8% ASR@10 on AdvBench. Trained with Llama3.1-8B-Instruct as the victim, it reached 71.0%

rejected.detail: The Llama3.1-8B-Instruct training victim detail is not present in any of the cited claims.
